summary: Inspects operator Python state such as storage, locals, globals, expressions, and extensions, returning filtered diagnostic tables for debugging.

key_params.note: Operator whose Python state will be inspected

key_params.name: source
key_params.note: Choose storage, locals, extensions, globals, or expression inspection

key_params.name: subkey
key_params.note: Narrow storage or dictionary inspection to a specific key path

key_params.name: expression
key_params.note: Expression to evaluate for expression-source inspection

key_params.name: level
key_params.note: Depth level to include when expanding nested objects

common_gotchas: Deep inspection of globals, project internals, or large storage dictionaries can produce large tables and expensive cooks.
DAT locals only apply to DAT module contexts; do not assume every operator exposes meaningful DAT local state.
Filtering by source, subkey, level, and columns is important before exposing inspection results to generated diagnostics.
Expansion of classes can reveal implementation details that are noisy for user-facing summaries.
key_concepts: Inspects Python objects such as operator storage, locals, globals, expressions, and extensions.
Source, subkey, and expression parameters choose which object or nested dictionary branch to inspect.
Filter fields constrain output by key, type, or value text.
Output format and column toggles determine whether level, key, type, and value fields are shown.
